I keep the 50g jar priced at ₹329 on the counter for weekend mornings when I want a proper brew without pulling out heavy equipment, while the 100g size at ₹559 easily carries us through the busy workweek. Reading the fine print used to feel like tedious homework, but turning this glass jar around reminds me that honest food doesn't need to hide behind complicated jargon. It is simply real coffee, made properly, in a reusable jar that sits proudly on the counter.

By knowing exactly what goes into our morning mug, we stop guessing what manufacturers are trying to mask with extra flavorings. Take a minute to check your own kitchen shelf today.
